name: Downtown Disney Paseo & Céntrico Roasted Chicken (Pollo) or Carne Asada with Rice & Tortillas (Plain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Paseo & Céntrico (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Chef Carlos Gaytán's kitchens at Paseo and Céntrico will prepare plain wood-grilled chicken breast or filet steak with white rice and warm tortillas upon request.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for plain grilled chicken or steak with steamed rice and warm tortillas—hold all chili moles, raw onions, and lime juice.
watchOuts: Avoid complex moles (contain nuts, seeds, chilies, and spices) and citrus aguachile/ceviche
